data.narrative:
Heart Aerospace, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Anders and Klara Forslund, has raised $185M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Sierra Space at $8.0B Series C, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Skyryse at $1.1B Series C), alongside five public Space & Aerospace peers trading at a median 24.4x price-to-sales.

Two valuation methods triangulate the target. Stage-progression methodology applies a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B to subsequent rounds, yielding $352M based on the $185M raised proxy. Peer-median analysis across the four comparable companies produces $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied owing to absence of revenue disclosure.

The two applicable methods support a triangulated range of $299M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The 6.3x spread between methods reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression assumes incremental capital dilution patterns, while peer medians are sensitive to Sierra Space's $8.0B outlier and sector heterogeneity. Key uncertainties include Heart Aerospace's revenue trajectory, capital efficiency versus comparables, and whether late-stage private valuations in space will sustain current multiples through exit.
